text: The proposed parking amendments on Tumpane Street, south of Heathrow Drive, are recommended to improve the operation of the existing short-term parking area fronting Tumpane Public School. The existing short-term parking area, which currently provides space for approximately six vehicles, will be increased to provide space for an additional three vehicles.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition, in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Tumpane Street, between Heathrow Drive and a point 95 metres south, to operate between Heathrow Drive and a point 76 metres south. 2. Amended the existing 15-minute maximum parking regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Tumpane Street, between a point 95 metres south of Heathrow Drive and a point 46.5 metres south, to operate between a point 76 metres south of Heathrow Drive and a point 65.5 metres further south.
